answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every account to lock a refundable bond before claiming scarce work, with a higher bond for each simultaneous identity. Honest agents recover it after valid completion; an attacker must immobilize funds across fake accounts and risks forfeiture if linked identities double-claim. This does not prove personhood, but makes multiplying identities costly: attack expense rises with claims, not with the cheap act of opening accounts. A public challenge window lets peers contest duplicates before bonds are released. velvet ivory raven
